stories.stat_label: years old, and a new mum
stories.headline: A 60-year-old flamingo named Queen just hatched 2 chicks
stories.summary: Queen, a Chilean flamingo at the Louisville Zoo, is believed to be the oldest female to hatch chicks at an accredited US zoo. The previous record holder was 50.
stories.why: Flamingos can skip nesting for years, so a healthy pair of chicks at 60 is rare.

stories.headline: 4 giant telescopes to catch cosmic blasts are now built
stories.summary: On a La Palma mountaintop, 4 telescopes with 23 m mirrors are complete. Each weighs about 100 tonnes yet can swing across the sky in 20 seconds to chase sudden gamma-ray flashes.
stories.why: They'll catch faint light from explosions that happened billions of years ago.

stories.headline: A 13,800-year-old camp may hold the Americas' oldest home
stories.summary: Near Fairbanks, diggers found thousands of artifacts, what may be the oldest dwelling and needles in the Western Hemisphere, and bones that could be the Americas' earliest pet dogs.
stories.why: Some of the first people in North America came back to this camp for about 1,000 years.

stories.headline: She cleaned a campus for 26 years. Now her daughter is Dr.
stories.summary: Ranu Devi started as a sanitation worker at BIT Mesra on ₹400 a week and kept her 3 kids in school. Her daughter Aarti has now earned an engineering PhD at the very same institute.
stories.why: Aarti is the first woman from her village to reach this milestone in engineering.

fun_fact: Flamingo chicks are born grey; their pink colour comes later, from pigments in the food they eat.
